<?php
// Read input
$line = trim(fgets(STDIN));
$n = (int)$line;

// Initialize the row with the first slime
$row = [1];

// Add the remaining n-1 slimes
for ($i = 1; $i < $n; $i++) {
    // Add a new slime with value 1 at the end
    $row[] = 1;
    
    // While the last two slimes have the same value, combine them
    while (count($row) >= 2) {
        $last = $row[count($row) - 1];
        $secondLast = $row[count($row) - 2];
        
        if ($last === $secondLast) {
            // Remove the last two slimes
            array_pop($row);
            array_pop($row);
            // Add the combined slime
            $row[] = $last + 1;
        } else {
            break;
        }
    }
}

// Output the final state
echo implode(' ', $row);
echo "\n";
?>

<?php
$input = trim(fgets(STDIN));
$n = (int)$input;

if ($n == 0) {
    echo "";
    exit;
}

// We simulate the process using a stack.
// The stack holds the values of the slimes in the row from left to right.
// When we add a new slime (value 1), we push it onto the stack.
// Then, while the top two elements are equal, we pop them and push their sum (value + 1).

$stack = [];

for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
    // Add a new slime with value 1
    $stack[] = 1;
    
    // Combine while the last two slimes have the same value
    while (count($stack) >= 2) {
        $last = $stack[count($stack) - 1];
        $secondLast = $stack[count($stack) - 2];
        
        if ($last == $secondLast) {
            // Pop the last two
            array_pop($stack);
            array_pop($stack);
            // Push the combined slime
            $stack[] = $last + 1;
        } else {
            break;
        }
    }
}

// Output the final state of the stack
echo implode(' ', $stack);
?>

Then, while the last two slimes in the row have the same value v, you combine them together to create a slime with value v + 1.You would like to see what the final state of the row is after you've added all n slimes. Output Specification: Output a single line with k integers, where k is the number of slimes in the row after you've finished the procedure described in the problem statement. The i-th of these numbers should be the value of the i-th slime from the left.

1

1

Sample Input:
2

2

3

2 1
